name: CFG-Zero★ (optimized scale, core)
plain: Rescales the negative prediction by the amount that best matches the positive, before CFG mixes them. The core node has no zero-init of early steps, only the optimized scale. It takes no parameters.
math:
α = ⟨x−x̂_c, x−x̂_u⟩ / (‖x−x̂_u‖²+1e-8), per batch item
x̂ = x̂_cfg + (α−1)·x̂_u + s·(1−α)·x̂_u
which equals α·x̂_u + s·(x̂_c − α·x̂_u).
α is measured in x−x̂ space and applied to x0 predictions.
label: from code
surprise: Core has no zero-init phase despite the name; alpha is computed on x−x̂ and applied to x̂.
